question: The first Municipal Corporation was set up during the British era in the former Presidency Town of _________ in 1688.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madras**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first **Municipal Corporation** in India was established in **Madras** (now Chennai) in the year **1688**.
 
• This was during the British colonial period when Madras was one of the major Presidency Towns.
